text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Putting on a display of overwhelming 
strength, Sweep Tosho crossed the finish 
line in a glorious 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Kawakami Princess and the others 
vow to try again despite their 
frustration, Sweep Tosho smiles with 
satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She declared that alongside the Umamusume 
who would become her disciple, she would 
fill the world with even more excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka, who 
had been watching, were also spellbound, 
determined that they would be the ones to 
forge a path into the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the little witch continues to walk 
her path alongside her friends. Next, she 
will cast a new magic upon the world 
together with the Umamusume of a new era.
